component.name: Valentina
component.summary: Provides a cross-platform patternmaking program which allows designers to create and model patterns of clothing

description.p: Valentina is a cross-platform patternmaking program which allows designers to create and model patterns of clothing. This software allows pattern creation, using either standard sizing tables or an individual’s set of measurements. It blends new technologies with traditional methods to create a unique pattern making tool.
This is a stable maintenance release in the 1.0 series.

ul.li: Valentina app. Fixed launching Tape or Puzzle from Valentina on macOS failing to find them when installed outside of /Applications directly.

Misc. Fixed nearly invisible placeholder text in disabled/read-only fields on custom dark theme and some Linux dark palettes.

Valentina app. Fixed the horizontal scroll wheel doing nothing on the pattern and layout views.
Valentina app / Tape app. Fixed placeholder and search-history menus splitting into multiple columns instead of scrolling on some Linux styles.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed exporting DXF files to a path containing non-Latin characters failing on Windows.

Valentina app. Fixed a point cut by length along a multi-segment curve sometimes landing far from the requested distance.
Valentina app. Fixed the pattern not recalculating after changing the default curve approximation scale in Preferences.

Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Stopped Qt painting warnings from popping an error dialog that could itself crash the application.
Valentina app. Fixed the tool history being lost after renaming a pattern piece, which crashed the application when the History dialog was opened.
Tape app. Fixed a crash while reading a measurement file whose format was not recognized.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash when opening Preferences after a monitor was disconnected or reconfigured.
Tape app. Fixed a crash while the known measurements database was being rebuilt in the background after its folder changed.

Valentina app. Fixed fold-line label font not updating live when changed in preferences.
Valentina app / Puzzle app. Fixed fold-line ("Cut on Fold") labels rendering upside down, mirrored, or offset on flipped pieces.

Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed a crash when redrawing the mode sidebar icons under low memory or degenerate tab sizes.

Valentina app. Fixed sporadic crash when opening a pattern file due to unsafe concurrent access to the same document.
Valentina app. Fixed use-after-free crashes triggered by a full reparse after undo/redo.
Valentina app. Fixed crash when toggling a piece's in-layout state for a tool of the wrong type in the pieces list.
Valentina app. Fixed release-build crash when undoing or redoing deletion of a piece.

description.p: This is a stable maintenance release in the 1.0 series.
